decisions.quote: Together, these results generally replicate previously-observed patterns ( Martucci et al., 2018 ) and extend these findings with new neuroimaging evidence about alterations of incentive processing in individuals with fibromyalgia.
decisions.reason: The authors state an overall positive replication verdict in both the abstract ('based on replicating prior univariate results... we provide further evidence of altered brain reward responses') and the discussion ('Together, these results generally replicate previously-observed patterns ( Martucci et al., 2018 )' and 'the present results support prior observations'). Although the authors note in the Limitations that the trends were weaker and did not cross the Bonferroni-corrected significance threshold, the codebook specifies that an overall verdict of support/replication governs and that weaker effect sizes or lack of statistical significance alone do not make an outcome 'mixed' when the authors treat the prior findings as supported.
